name: crux-compress
description: Compress rules, code, images, and web pages into CRUX notation, with CRUX memories and meditation. Packages the CRUX-Compress release as a plugin.

interface.longDescription: CRUX (Context Reduction Using X-encoding) compresses markdown rules, code files, images, and web pages into a dense notation that agents read directly, typically to a quarter of the original tokens. The plugin packages the CRUX-Compress release: the rule manager agent, /crux-compress, CRUX memories (dream, recall, remember, forget), and memory-informed meditation. Run /z-crux-init once per project to add CRUX.md and the AGENTS.md block. Hooks and scripts need Python 3.
